title: OLEANDER Landscape Architecture Design Process v1.0
purpose: Run authentic landscape-architecture development from land/site evidence and briefing through concept, spatial and technical design, construction administration, establishment, stewardship and lifecycle review while preserving survey, ecology, water, civil, planning and field-authority boundaries.
scope_in: topography, grading, levels and external movement
surface-water and landscape water strategy interfaces
hardscape, site furniture and external material systems
maintenance, stewardship and in-use landscape performance
end-of-use, reuse and recycling where lifecycle scope is triggered
scope_out: automatic legal boundary or survey authority
automatic civil or hydraulic engineering approval
automatic ecology or biodiversity field verification
authority_position: Subordinate to OLEANDER Master Runtime, Professional Domain Process Contract, Current Knowledge Authority, Cross-Disciplinary Integration, project appointment and applicable landscape, planning, ecology, civil, hydrology, geotechnical and statutory authority.

trigger.project_flow_trigger: A material project claim requires professional landscape judgment about land, public/open space, topography, soils, water, ecology, planting, hardscape, external movement, construction, establishment or stewardship.
design_question_types: levels, water, movement and spatial coordination
responsibility_triggers: planting, soils or water-performance claim has project consequence
external accessibility or movement claim is material
landscape construction, establishment or maintenance claim is made
trigger.claim_ceiling_rule: The lowest applicable current claim ceiling across land/survey authority, mounted site/ecology/water evidence, interface maturity, native landscape evidence, construction/establishment readback and external professional/statutory authority governs.
not_triggered_when: decorative planting or reference imagery with explicit exclusion of professional landscape claims
mandatory_reopen_triggers: boundary, survey, datum or topography change
geotechnical, soil, ecology, hydrology or drainage evidence change
establishment or in-use evidence materially contradicts design assumptions

knowledge_binding.consequential_knowledge_rule: Consequential survey, planning, soil, ecology, water, accessibility, planting, civil, product and field evidence must be admitted through task/claim-scoped Operational Mount before supporting a professional landscape decision.
required_methods: current OLEANDER design-quality and professional-domain process contracts
Landscape Institute professional stage and scope-of-services methods
theory_routes: landscape spatial experience and public realm
source_routes: Landscape Institute Digital Plan of Work / Scope of Services lineage
applicable landscape, accessibility, planting, product and construction requirements
evidence_routes: soil and geotechnical evidence where applicable
ecology and habitat evidence where applicable
standard_code_routes: current jurisdictional planning and landscape requirements
precedent_case_routes: landscape cases with comparable climate, use, ecology, water, construction and stewardship conditions

stages.professional_question: What land, authority, environmental and strategic conditions determine whether and how landscape scope should proceed?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount consequential authority/site evidence before strategic landscape claims close.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: current site/authority evidence plus project responsibility register
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen LA-PW0 consumers when authority, boundary, scope or controlling site evidence changes materially.

human_experience_consequences: defines who and what the landscape must serve
design_language_consequences: sets initial landscape identity and place-reading constraints
technical_consequences: identifies survey, soil, water, ecology and civil evidence required
content_projection_requirements: show authority, known conditions, unknowns and claim ceiling together
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review of strategic landscape scope and evidence gaps before consequential closure.
open_items_allowed: non-controlling evidence acquisition may remain scheduled
exit_conditions: scope, controlling evidence needs and responsibilities are explicit

stages.professional_question: What site, community, ecological, water, operational and maintenance brief should govern landscape development?
entry_conditions: LA-PW0 strategic scope resolved to current claim ceiling
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount consequential site, user, ecology, water and maintenance evidence before briefing decisions close.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: current survey/site evidence and coordinated landscape brief
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen brief consumers when site, stakeholder, ecology, water or maintenance assumptions change materially.

human_experience_consequences: defines access, use, comfort, inclusion and seasonal experience requirements
design_language_consequences: defines place character and experiential tensions without fixing form prematurely
technical_consequences: defines performance criteria for levels, water, soil, planting and maintenance
content_projection_requirements: co-locate landscape requirement with source/authority and unresolved limitation
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review of brief completeness and controlling evidence assumptions.
exit_conditions: landscape brief and controlling evidence basis are coherent

stages.professional_question: Which landscape system concept best resolves landform, movement, water, ecology, use, identity and stewardship together?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount consequential precedent and environmental evidence before selecting a concept as professional basis.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: native landscape concept drawings/model plus current interface register
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen selected concept relations when controlling building, civil, ecology, utility, level or water strategy changes.

human_experience_consequences: defines approach, sequence, gathering, comfort and seasonal experience
design_language_consequences: establishes landscape generative grammar, material/planting character and signature moves
technical_consequences: sets concept landform, water, soil, planting and hardscape systems
content_projection_requirements: show alternatives, selection basis, trade-offs and does-not-prove boundary
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent concept review against brief, site evidence and cross-domain consequences.
open_items_allowed: bounded technical sizing and specialist confirmation may remain open
exit_conditions: selected landscape concept is coherent and interface-capable at concept ceiling

stages.professional_question: Are levels, movement, water, planting zones, structures, utilities and building thresholds spatially coordinated?
entry_conditions: landscape concept selected at current ceiling
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount consequential current technical and authority evidence used to coordinate spatial decisions.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: coordinated native landscape/site drawings or model plus Integration register
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen affected coordination when level, route, threshold, drainage, structure, utility or root-zone geometry changes.

human_experience_consequences: proves continuous movement, access, use sequence and spatial comfort at coordinated level
design_language_consequences: tests whether concept language survives real grading, routes and service constraints
technical_consequences: coordinates dimensional levels, gradients, drainage paths, utilities and planting zones
content_projection_requirements: figures must expose levels, legends, interface constraints and unresolved blockers
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent spatial-coordination review of critical landscape interfaces.
exit_conditions: critical spatial interfaces meet required Integration maturity for this claim ceiling

stages.professional_question: Are landscape systems, details, materials, planting, soils, water interfaces and performance requirements technically resolved for the appointed scope?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount consequential technical, plant, soil, material/product and regulatory evidence before technical closure.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: technical native landscape documents plus verified specialist/interface inputs
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen affected technical packages when coordinated geometry, product, plant, soil, drainage, utility or authority basis changes.

human_experience_consequences: resolves tactile, accessible, comfortable and maintainable landscape conditions
design_language_consequences: resolves material, edge, planting, water and detail grammar at construction scale
technical_consequences: defines technical performance, interfaces, tolerances and maintenance requirements
content_projection_requirements: technical claims must retain units, authority, assumptions and unresolved interfaces
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent technical landscape review proportionate to risk and appointment.
open_items_allowed: specialist production items only where responsibility and acceptance route are explicit
exit_conditions: appointed technical landscape scope is internally coherent and interface-ready

stages.professional_question: Do production information, submittals, procurement and constructed landscape work remain consistent with the current landscape intent and technical requirements?
entry_conditions: technical landscape basis issued for applicable construction/procurement scope
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount consequential product, plant, field and authority evidence before acceptance decisions.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: issued construction information plus actual submittal/site/change records
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen affected technical/coordination decisions when site change or substitution changes the designed relation.

human_experience_consequences: checks whether built landscape preserves intended use and sensory conditions
design_language_consequences: checks constructed material, edge, planting and detail fidelity
technical_consequences: records field conformity, substitution, defect and acceptance boundaries
content_projection_requirements: distinguish design intent, reviewed submittal and observed installed condition
required_readback: actual site/submittal readback at sampled/contracted scope
stages.professional_review_owner: Landscape Architecture professional owner within appointment
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review for material high-risk changes or acceptance claims where required.
open_items_allowed: tracked defects and establishment items with owner/date may remain open
exit_conditions: construction-stage professional obligations for the claimed scope are read back and dispositioned
does_not_prove: complete field conformity beyond observed scope

stages.professional_question: Is the completed landscape handed over with defects, establishment, maintenance, asset and responsibility information sufficient for transition into operation?
entry_conditions: relevant landscape work substantially complete at project-defined threshold
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount consequential handover, plant and maintenance evidence before close claims.

interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen handover state when defects, establishment failures or as-built discrepancies materially affect accepted scope.

human_experience_consequences: transitions landscape into safe and usable operation while living systems establish
design_language_consequences: preserves intended landscape character through establishment and maintenance instructions
technical_consequences: records residual defects, establishment obligations and asset/maintenance information
content_projection_requirements: handover status must co-locate residual defects, responsibilities and claim limits
stages.professional_review_owner: Landscape Architecture professional owner within appointment
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent handover review where project risk or appointment requires it.
exit_conditions: handover responsibilities and establishment state are explicit at current ceiling

stages.professional_question: How does the landscape actually perform in use, maintenance, ecology, water, planting and public experience, and what bounded changes or lessons follow?
entry_conditions: landscape is in use or meaningful establishment/performance evidence exists
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount consequential measured/observed evidence before in-use performance claims or reusable lessons.

interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Material in-use contradiction creates a bounded reopen or Evolution/G9 candidate; it does not rewrite original evidence.

human_experience_consequences: evaluates actual use, comfort, access, identity and seasonal experience
design_language_consequences: tests whether intended landscape character persists or adapts coherently over time
technical_consequences: evaluates maintenance, plant, water and material performance using observed evidence
content_projection_requirements: separate design prediction, observed result, inference and proposed adaptation
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review before project experience is generalized into reusable professional knowledge.
open_items_allowed: long-term trends may remain under monitoring
exit_conditions: bounded in-use conclusions and next actions are evidence-linked

stages.professional_question: When lifecycle scope is triggered, how should landscape materials, soils, plants, water systems and site assets be retained, adapted, reused, recycled or decommissioned without erasing provenance and residual risks?
entry_conditions: end-of-use, major renewal or decommissioning scope is materially triggered
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount consequential current environmental, material and authority evidence before end-of-use decisions close.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: current asset/site evidence plus approved lifecycle strategy
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen end-of-use strategy when asset condition, environmental evidence, authority or reuse route changes materially.

human_experience_consequences: considers continuity of public use, memory and transition during renewal/decommissioning
design_language_consequences: defines what landscape identity is retained, adapted or intentionally ended
technical_consequences: defines bounded retention, reuse, recycling and environmental handling requirements
content_projection_requirements: separate retained asset, reuse candidate, waste/decommissioning path and unresolved authority
stages.professional_review_owner: Landscape Architecture professional owner with applicable specialists
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review proportionate to environmental, safety and lifecycle risk.
open_items_allowed: future route only when explicit trigger and owner remain
exit_conditions: bounded lifecycle strategy and responsibilities are explicit

controlling_authority_requirements: site/boundary/survey authority remains with its current owner
interface_contract.interface_maturity_policy: Each stage references required interface maturity through its bindings; Cross-Disciplinary Integration remains the sole owner of actual maturity, disposition, coupling, criticality and acceptance state.
allowed_open_interface_conditions: an OPEN interface may remain only when it does not exceed the stage claim ceiling and has explicit owner, consequence and reopen trigger
integration_readback_requirements: read back actual coordinated geometry/data at material interfaces
preserve interface owner and unresolved blocker
do not infer Integration PASS from landscape-stage closure

native_source_of_truth_rules: native editable landscape source remains authority over previews/renders
survey/site evidence is referenced rather than redrawn as authority
derived images do not replace dimensional or field evidence
execution_owner_requirements: resolve professional owner before consequential landscape mutation
use minimum sufficient capability/Skill/tool owner set
tool_adapter_requirements: tool route must preserve coordinates/levels/object identity where material
tool success cannot self-award professional PASS
actual_readback_requirements: read back field/establishment/in-use evidence when claims depend on it

assurance.professional_review: Landscape-stage professional review by the responsible landscape owner at the applicable claim ceiling.
assurance.evidence_review: Verify authority, applicability, freshness and scope of consequential survey/site/ecology/water/soil/plant/material/field evidence.
assurance.independent_review: Independent review is required where the stage definition, project risk, Evolution promotion or professional governance calls for it; independence must be recorded rather than inferred.
assurance.receipt_contract: Professional process/stage receipts must bind actual outputs, readback, mounted knowledge, interface refs, verdict, claim ceiling, open items and does-not-prove boundaries.

stale_scope_rules: stale only consumers of the materially changed relation
upstream_impact_rules: if failure reveals a brief, evidence or concept contradiction, reopen smallest sufficient upstream landscape stage
downstream_impact_rules: stale affected technical outputs, interfaces, field acceptance, handover or in-use claims that consume the changed relation
interface_reopen_rules: delegate actual interface maturity/disposition reopen to Cross-Disciplinary Integration
receipt_stale_rules: mark only receipts consuming changed evidence/interface/artifact stale
do not silently reinterpret old receipts under new process semantics

process_exit_conditions: all triggered landscape stages required by the current claim ceiling are closed or explicitly outside claim
consequential knowledge mounts and required readbacks exist
material interfaces meet required Integration conditions
professional verdict and open items are explicit
open_items_allowed: only items allowed by the current stage/claim ceiling with explicit owner, consequence and reopen trigger
completion_contract.professional_receipt: DOMAIN_PROCESS_INSTANCE / domain-stage receipts compiled through the Professional Domain Process Contract; no separate universal landscape PASS token is created.
completion_contract.promotion_effect: A Landscape professional PASS may satisfy the R-E dependency for its bounded scope only; it does not award Design KEEP, Integration PASS, statutory approval or human Promotion.
